NAME: AHB-Lite interconnect verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-AHB-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Full compliance with AHB-Lite IHI 0033A single-master-at-a-time ...
details: Full compliance with AHB-Lite IHI 0033A, single-master-at-a-time semantics.
implementation_note: Source: Protocol

NAME: t_ahb_protocol
details: Oracle: AHB-Lite protocol checker, zero violations
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing (existing RTL). Bench: tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v, five instances in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (the masters and the stream the slaves see): VIOLATIONS 0 on each over the whole run (sim/tb_ahb_ic/run.log). Bench total 802 checks, 0 failures, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 Four masters I-port D-port Debug SBA DMA.
details: Four masters: I-port, D-port, Debug SBA, DMA.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0004, 0012

NAME: t_ahb_four_masters
details: Oracle: all four masters complete transfers Coverage goal: all 4
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new (M2 is new). Bench: tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv: T1, T4 and T16 run the I-port, D-port and DMA masters; T17 runs the debug SBA master (write and read of ISRAM and DSRAM). PASS; bench total 802 checks, 0 failures, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 Four slave regions ISRAM Boot ROM DSRAM APB.
details: Four slave regions: ISRAM, Boot ROM, DSRAM, APB.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_ahb_decode
details: Oracle: every HADDR[31:28] value selects the right slave Coverage goal: all 16
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T1 (one transfer to each of the four regions), T1b (base and last word of ISRAM and DSRAM), T2 (HSEL one-hot on every cycle), T3 (unmapped address). PASS. The sweep of all 16 HADDR[31:28] values in the plan is not run as such.

NAME: R-4 Every master shall be able to reach every slave it is permitted ...
details: Every master shall be able to reach every slave it is permitted to address. No structural reachability restriction.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0005

NAME: t_ahb_reachability
details: Oracle: the four cover properties above all hit Coverage goal: 4/4 covers
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new — the Rev 3.1 regression guard. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - the four cover properties are not implemented. Reachability is checked by transfers instead: tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T1 (D-port to all four regions), T16 (I-port to ISRAM, D-port to DSRAM, DMA to the bridge) and T17 (SBA write to ISRAM). PASS.

NAME: R-5 Fixed-priority arbitration re-evaluated every beat never inside a ...
details: Fixed-priority arbitration, re-evaluated every beat, never inside a data phase.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0004

NAME: t_ahb_priority
details: Oracle: under simultaneous request, highest priority wins Coverage goal: all 6 master pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T4: DMA, D-port and I-port request in the same cycle and are accepted in priority order; that is 3 of the 6 master pairs. The three pairs with the SBA master are not driven as simultaneous requests.

NAME: t_ahb_grant_lock
details: Oracle: a_grant_stable_in_data_phase under random contention
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T5 (per-master hold: ungranted masters frozen, grant stable), T14 (HWDATA follows the data-phase master) and T16 (randomised three-master soak: every master retires all 24 transfers with the right data), with the slave-side protocol checker at 0 violations. PASS.

NAME: R-6 An undecoded address shall produce a two-cycle ERROR never a hang.
details: An undecoded address shall produce a two-cycle ERROR, never a hang.
implementation_note: Source: Protocol

NAME: t_ahb_error
details: Oracle: undecoded address → two-cycle ERROR → precise fault Coverage goal: all 12 unused encodings
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T3 and T3b (unmapped read and write give a two-cycle ERROR, four back-to-back, no hang, bus recovers), T9 and T9b (ERROR from a mapped slave, not broadcast). PASS. The plan's sweep of all 12 unused encodings is not run as such. With the core: sw/tests/t_buserr.S gives a precise fault (PASS, also under wait states after TB-29).

NAME: R-7 The interconnect shall report to the ISRAM slave when the granted ...
details: The interconnect shall report to the ISRAM slave when the granted master is SBA.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0006

NAME: t_ahb_sba_ind
details: Oracle: hmaster_is_sba follows the grant; ISRAM lock bypass works
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T17 and the monitor sba_ind_viol (hmaster_is_sba compared with the grant on every hclk). PASS. The ISRAM lock bypass itself is in the memory plan (t_isram_sba_write).

NAME: R-8 Zero wait states inserted by the interconnect itself.
details: Zero wait states inserted by the interconnect itself.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_ahb_zero_wait
details: Oracle: no interconnect-inserted wait state
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T8 checks that slave wait states pass through and every transfer completes with correct data; there is no check that counts wait states added by the interconnect itself.

NAME: R-9 A master s burst shall not be corrupted by losing arbitration ...
details: A master's burst shall not be corrupted by losing arbitration mid-burst.
implementation_note: Source: Protocol

NAME: t_ahb_burst_preempt
details: Oracle: INCR burst preempted mid-burst, restarts NONSEQ, no data lost Coverage goal: preempt at each beat position
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T11 (uninterrupted INCR burst), T12 (DMA preempts a continuously requesting I-port), T13 (the preempted master keeps its data), T15 (a stolen SEQ is re-opened as NONSEQ on the slave side). PASS. Preemption at each beat position is not swept.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_ahb_starvation
details: Oracle: M0 progresses under sustained M1+M3 load
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv T16 shows the I-port retiring all 24 transfers under random traffic from the D-port and the DMA; there is no sustained-load starvation test of the lowest-priority master. T12 checks the opposite case (the DMA is not starved by the I-port, erratum AHB-2).

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_grant_onehot
details: exactly one master granted at a time
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. The grant in the RTL is a 2-bit encoded index, so two masters cannot be granted together by construction.

NAME: a_grant_stable_in_data_phase
details: THE critical property: grant never moves inside a data phase
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T5 per-master hold rule; T14 HWDATA is a data-phase signal).

NAME: a_hsel_onehot
details: HSEL is one-hot including the default slave
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T2: HSEL was one-hot on every cycle, monitor sel_onehot_viol).

NAME: a_no_black_hole
details: every unused decode lands on the default slave, never nowhere
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T3 and T3b: unmapped accesses return ERROR and retire, no hang).

NAME: a_error_two_cycle
details: ERROR is always exactly two cycles
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked by tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v (0 violations) and in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T3: no one-cycle ERROR seen by the master; T9).

NAME: a_error_first_cycle
details: ERROR never appears with HREADY high in the first cycle
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked by tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v (0 violations).

NAME: c_m1_reaches_isram
details: Checked as a cover, not an assert: this is the property Rev 3.1 broke.
implementation_note: cover property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as a cover property. The transfer itself is checked in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T1: ISRAM read data).

NAME: c_m1_reaches_bootrom
implementation_note: cover property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as a cover property. The transfer itself is checked in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T1: ROM read data).

NAME: c_m0_reaches_dsram
implementation_note: cover property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as a cover property. No check in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv is labelled for an I-port transfer to DSRAM.

NAME: c_m2_reaches_isram_write
implementation_note: cover property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as a cover property. The transfer itself is checked in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T17: SBA write/read ISRAM).

NAME: a_sba_ind
details: sba indication tracks the grant exactly
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (monitor sba_ind_viol, every hclk).

NAME: a_no_inserted_wait
details: no wait states inserted by the interconnect itself
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only; see t_ahb_zero_wait.

NAME: a_ungranted_held
details: an ungranted requesting master is held, never loses its address
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T5) and by the master-side protocol checkers.

NAME: a_burst_restart_nonseq
details: burst restart is NONSEQ after preemption
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T15: burst split on the slave side).

NAME: a_reset_state
details: reset state: M0 granted, HREADY high, no slave selected
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv (T0: reset state).
